disposition_mapping.rationale: Extraction of locked-period actuals is merged with comparatives loading into a single automated ingestion pipeline. The mandatory locked-period actuals input is preserved in TGT-01, satisfying VAR-R-01.
Loading of the approved budget and latest forecast is merged with actuals extraction into the same ingestion pipeline, retaining both required comparator inputs as mandated by VAR-R-02.

Variance computation is restructured as an automated, version-controlled engine rather than manual analyst calculation, but continues to consume the accounting policies applied to actuals (VAR-R-05) and constant-currency exchange rates (VAR-R-06), preserving policy consistency (KB-06) and FX translation discipline (KB-07, KB-08).

Application of materiality thresholds is automated into a rules-based screen, satisfying VAR-R-08 (step survives) and VAR-R-03 (percentage and absolute thresholds remain required inputs). The step's actor remains distinct from the reviewer in TGT-06, preserving the separation required by VAR-R-04.
Budget holder commentary is unconstrained by design and retained substantially unchanged, with a structured template added for traceability but no change to actor or accountability.

Consolidation and drafting is restructured to auto-populate the report from the variance and commentary datasets, reducing manual compilation while the analyst retains responsibility for resolving gaps before review.
Review and challenge survives as a distinct manager-led control per VAR-R-07, performed by an actor separate from the materiality-selection step as required by VAR-R-04.
Presentation and distribution to management is unconstrained by design and retained, enhanced with a self-service distribution channel but no change to the underlying function or actor.

steps.description: A scheduled pipeline pulls actuals from the locked, closed period and loads the approved budget version and latest forecast as comparatives in the same pass, eliminating manual re-keying while preserving the mandatory source inputs for each leg.
steps.name: Automated extraction and load of actuals and comparatives

steps.description: A rules-based variance engine computes price, volume and mix variances on actuals and budget prepared under the same accounting policy basis, isolating the FX effect at constant currency. The engine's policy and rate parameters are version-controlled so policy continuity and FX treatment remain auditable.
steps.name: Automated price, volume, mix and FX-isolated variance computation

steps.description: An automated threshold screen flags every variance exceeding either the percentage or the absolute materiality threshold for mandatory explanation; the FP&A analyst owns the threshold parameters and reviews edge cases, but does not perform the downstream challenge review, preserving separation of duties.
steps.name: Apply materiality thresholds to select variances for explanation

steps.description: Accountable budget holders provide commentary on the selected variances, submitted through a structured commentary template that links each explanation to its variance line.
steps.name: Obtain commentary from budget holders

steps.description: Variances and commentary are auto-populated into a standard report template and consolidated into a single draft, with the analyst resolving any gaps or inconsistencies before handoff to review.
steps.name: Auto-draft and consolidate variance report

steps.description: The draft report and its commentary are reviewed and challenged by a manager who did not perform the materiality-based selection, preserving independent review of what was selected for explanation and how it was explained.
steps.name: Review and challenge

steps.description: The reviewed report is presented and distributed to management, including via a self-service dashboard for ad hoc drill-down into the underlying variance dataset.
steps.name: Present and distribute to management
